critical_code_review_comments: data-testid coverage asymmetry: only three sidebar items currently expose dk-nav-* testids (dk-nav-private, dk-nav-privacy, dk-nav-track). The remaining sidebar items (Overview, Vanish, Swap, Bridge out, Pay, Request, Cash out, Yield, History, Burner addresses, Referrals, Vault & keys) are reachable only by visible text, which is brittle for localized or renamed labels. Suggest adding dk-nav-overview, dk-nav-vanish, dk-nav-swap, dk-nav-bridge-out, dk-nav-pay, dk-nav-request, dk-nav-cash-out, dk-nav-yield, dk-nav-history, dk-nav-burner-addresses, dk-nav-referrals, dk-nav-vault-keys testids on the matching anchor/button elements for stable automated testing (the review request explicitly listed these).

Recovery-key payload begins with a lowercase 'veilsk' prefix (e.g. 'veilsk2qvxFNqTXkSVVzRE3BP672A6XWsHrTjvnNiXvbD...'). This is a functional identifier in the key encoding, not visible branding — the task note explicitly allows this, and capitalized 'Veil' is 0 in both HTML and body text. However, user-facing eyes may still associate 'veil' with the upstream brand. Consider renaming the key prefix (e.g. 'cadsk1') on the next schema bump if backwards-compatibility window permits.

A benign 404 appears in the console on every /api/bifrost/v1/app/ load (unspecified resource). Not failing the page, but worth tracing (likely a legacy asset reference) and removing to keep DevTools console clean.
